npcs.name: Yrsa
npcs.dialogue: I saw tracks leading away from the silent watchpost toward the frozen brook. Siv hopes the wardens found shelter.

npcs.name: Leif
npcs.dialogue: The watchpost beacon guides travelers across the ice. Hakon and I are checking the old trail for fallen branches.

npcs.name: Astrid
npcs.dialogue: I keep blankets ready at Snowthread. Yrsa found a warden’s scarf by the brook; its owner may be waiting out the storm.

npcs.name: Zara
npcs.dialogue: Welcome to Sunwell. The dunes stretch beyond our sandstone homes. I trade desert clothing: wear it to gather 20% more berries.

npcs.name: Safiya
npcs.dialogue: Our spice caravan is late. Its last message mentioned the buried mile markers beyond Sunwell. Amir knows the old route.

npcs.name: Idris
npcs.dialogue: I repair the well and caravan stones. A sandstorm covered the route markers; Safiya fears the caravan followed the wrong ridge.

npcs.name: Noor
npcs.dialogue: I keep water ready at the Sunwell cistern. The overdue caravan carried spare well ropes; Zara is saving provisions for its return.

npcs.name: Rafi
npcs.dialogue: I found a strip of caravan cloth near a buried marker. Idris remembers where the older road crossed the dunes.

npcs.name: Samira
npcs.dialogue: At Dune Loom I dye cloth bright enough to see through blowing sand. Rafi brought back a torn strip in our caravan colors.

npcs.name: Farid
npcs.dialogue: The Amber Rest has empty beds waiting for Safiya’s caravan. Their last letter spoke of a sheltered ruin beside the old road.

npcs.name: Eira
npcs.dialogue: Our snowy village is a warm stop on the ice fields. Stay awhile and rest before your next journey.

npcs.name: Siv
npcs.dialogue: The northern watchpost has stopped lighting its beacon. Eira is keeping our hearth warm for the wardens when they return.

npcs.name: Hakon
npcs.dialogue: I split timber at Pineworks. The watchpost asked for a new beacon frame before the blizzard; Boreal still has their message.

npcs.name: Yrsa
npcs.dialogue: I saw tracks leading away from the silent watchpost toward the frozen brook. Siv hopes the wardens found shelter.

npcs.name: Leif
npcs.dialogue: The watchpost beacon guides travelers across the ice. Hakon and I are checking the old trail for fallen branches.

npcs.name: Astrid
npcs.dialogue: I keep blankets ready at Snowthread. Yrsa found a warden’s scarf by the brook; its owner may be waiting out the storm.

npcs.name: Inga
npcs.dialogue: The Hearth Rest has hot broth for anyone coming off the ice. Leif promised to bring news from the silent watchpost.

npcs.dialogue: Our spice caravan is late. Its last message mentioned the buried mile markers beyond Sunwell. Amir knows the old route.

npcs.dialogue: I repair the well and caravan stones. A sandstorm covered the route markers; Safiya fears the caravan followed the wrong ridge.

npcs.name: Noor
npcs.dialogue: I keep water ready at the Sunwell cistern. The overdue caravan carried spare well ropes; Zara is saving provisions for its return.

npcs.name: Rafi
npcs.dialogue: I found a strip of caravan cloth near a buried marker. Idris remembers where the older road crossed the dunes.

npcs.name: Samira
npcs.dialogue: At Dune Loom I dye cloth bright enough to see through blowing sand. Rafi brought back a torn strip in our caravan colors.

npcs.name: Farid

npcs.dialogue: The remedies at Willow Still are running low. A herb shipment vanished along the lantern causeway; Fen last saw its boat.

npcs.name: Bracken
npcs.dialogue: I mend flat-bottomed boats at Reedworks. The missing herb boat had a split pole; someone may have taken shelter at the old sluice.

npcs.name: Nessa

npcs.name: Osier

npcs.name: Tansy
npcs.dialogue: Sedge taught me to dry willow leaves at Willow Still. I saved a little medicine for the boat crew, if they return.

npcs.name: Mirel
